warnings.warning: The amendment in equation (5) is flattened so the exponent and the power of N run together. The reading follows the prose: exponential in length and freshness, power of the record count.
Equation (7) for individual demand is scrambled, with the risk term's sums detached from their indices. It is read as the ratio times price minus a risk term weighted over the group.
The Bellman expectation in equation (10) is broken across lines. The stay-and-switch split follows the prose description of delta.
The similarity definition and the threshold neighbor are garbled, with indices floating free. The dot-product and threshold readings follow the prose and Algorithm 2.
Equation (20) prints the sum and the logarithm on separate lines. The sum of log of one plus data size follows the figure caption and the prose.
The clustering sensitivity metric beside the retention equation is defined but illegible. Only the retention difference-in-difference is transcribed; the metric survives as the tabulated deltas.
